findings: Default MSAA framebuffer varied pixels with identical camera, geometry and draw order; shadows/dithering/alpha changes did not remove it. No-MSAA and explicit FXAA each yielded twelve equal frame hashes per candidate on this workstation.
Production uses camera-owned FXAA with default MSAA off; this changes AA appearance and adds one full-screen draw call. It is not a claim of an upstream driver defect.
Late scene readiness now schedules a final rendered transition before idling; controlled gate was red before fix and passes in every final UI run.

Harness now wraps three renders in engine beginFrame/endFrame; samples assert frame-counter progression and resource checks include uniform buffers. ObjectRenderer resets scene-UBO pool per engine frame.
limitations: Local 91-entity fixture, not 200k+ sqm capacity or device qualification.
No presented FPS or general latency speedup claim; raw CPU/readiness/heap samples remain descriptive.
Heap includes diagnostic sample retention/JIT caches; stable live counts are not complete GPU memory accounting.
Visual review of FXAA appearance and write-access GitHub approval remain required before merge.
